## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated (unit and/or integration)
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md`, `docs/`) when behaviour or configuration changes
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Security and privacy (LGPD) impact considered (new data collected? new endpoint? new dependency?)
